visual_goal: Show financial master data flowing from a few authoring points into two hubs (a central financial master data hub and a partner hub) that broadcast to many subscribing systems, which receive but do not create.
prompt: A left-to-right hub-and-spoke illustration. At the far left, three small source boxes stacked vertically: 'Workday HCM', 'Entity register' and 'Treasury', each with one arrow into a large central hub shaped like a glowing round server labeled 'Financial master data hub'. Below them, two more source boxes: 'Brand platforms' and 'Northmere Pay', each with one arrow into a second, smaller round hub below the first, labeled 'Partner hub'. On the right side, a column of six receiving boxes, each drawn with a small closed padlock showing it receives only: 'SAP S/4HANA', 'Oracle Fusion', 'Workday Financials', 'OneStream', 'BlackLine', 'FinDB'. Thin blue arrows fan out from the 'Financial master data hub' to all six receiving boxes. Teal arrows go from the 'Partner hub' to 'SAP S/4HANA', to 'FinDB', to a small box 'Vertex' at the lower right, and one arrow back left to 'Northmere Pay'. The authoring side on the left sits on a soft green panel; the receivers on the right sit on a soft blue panel.
alt: Few authoring sources feed a financial master data hub and a partner hub, which distribute to many padlocked subscriber systems such as SAP S/4HANA, Oracle Fusion, Workday Financials, OneStream, BlackLine, FinDB and Vertex.

visual_goal: Show a chart of accounts change as a controlled flow: triage, three classes with different approval routes, then build, activate, publish, acknowledgment and an archived evidence pack.
prompt: A top-to-bottom process illustration with a gentle S-shaped path. At the top, a small document icon labeled 'Change request' with one arrow down to a magnifier box 'Steward triage'. From 'Steward triage' one small grey arrow goes left to a returned envelope labeled 'Rejected'. One arrow goes down from 'Steward triage' to a three-way signpost labeled 'Change class'. From the signpost three lanes go down side by side: the left lane is a short lane labeled 'Standard' with a two-person 'Four-eyes' approval icon; the middle lane is labeled 'Significant' and has three stacked boxes in a row going down: 'Impact analysis', 'Group reporting approval', and a small diamond 'SOX review'; the right lane is labeled 'Structural' with a meeting table icon 'Data Council'. All three lanes merge with arrows into one box 'Build and test'. Below it a straight chain of arrows: 'Activate at period start' with a calendar-page icon, then 'Publish event' with a lightning bolt, then 'Consumers acknowledge' with several small check marks, ending at a closed archive box labeled 'Evidence pack'.
alt: A chart of accounts change request is triaged, classified as standard, significant or structural with different approvals, then built, activated at period start, published as an event, acknowledged by consumers and archived as an evidence pack.

visual_goal: Show the partner master as coexistence: partners born in the brand extranet, matched in a hub with a steward queue that assigns the group partner ID and distributes it, with bank attributes coming only from the payments platform into the hub.
prompt: A left-to-right illustration. At the far left, a laptop showing a sign-up form, labeled 'Partner extranet', with one arrow into a box 'SFP'. One arrow from 'SFP' into a large central round hub labeled 'Partner hub', with a small ID tag icon on it labeled 'Group partner ID'. Directly above the hub, a small desk with an unlabeled person and an inbox tray labeled 'Steward queue', with one arrow from the hub up to it and one arrow from it back down to the hub, forming a small loop. Below the hub, a vault-like box labeled 'Northmere Pay' holding a small bank-building icon and a shield, with one thick orange arrow pointing up into the hub, labeled 'verified bank details'. From 'Northmere Pay' one more arrow goes down-right to a box 'Adyen'. On the right, three boxes receive one arrow each from the hub: 'SAP FI-CA', 'Vertex' and 'FinDB'. In total exactly nine arrows.
alt: Partners created in the extranet flow through SFP into a partner hub with a steward queue and a group partner ID; the hub distributes to SAP FI-CA, Vertex and FinDB, while verified bank details flow from Northmere Pay into the hub and on to Adyen.

visual_goal: Show finance lineage with two strands: a data strand from the reported revenue line back to Workday journals and Stripe Billing records, and a rule strand to the mapping rule set with its approvals and the FX rate set.
prompt: A right-to-left lineage illustration with plain, blank icons. At the far right, a plain framed report page with one highlighted bar labeled 'Group revenue line'. One arrow points left into a box with stacked cubes labeled 'OneStream'. From 'OneStream' two strands go left. The upper strand is a solid blue line labeled 'data strand' that passes three stations, with one arrow between each: a plain blank grid sheet labeled 'Tablekin trial balance', then a closed book labeled 'Workday journals', then a plain stack of blank papers labeled 'Stripe Billing records'. The lower strand is a dashed orange line labeled 'rule strand' that reaches a closed binder labeled 'Mapping rules', which has one more dashed arrow left to a blank paper with a round stamp labeled 'Approvals'. A second dashed orange arrow goes from 'OneStream' down-left to a plain blank card with two circular arrows labeled 'FX rates'. All icons are blank: no writing, numbers, symbols or tags on any icon. In total exactly seven arrows, all pointing left.
alt: Lineage from a group revenue line through OneStream back along a data strand to Tablekin's trial balance, Workday journals and Stripe Billing records, and along a rule strand to the mapping rule set with its change approvals and the FX rate set.
